summary.text: Josh Smead is the Democratic nominee for the open Missouri 6th District seat. A licensed architect and small-business owner from Liberty, Missouri, he has not held elected office and is campaigning on revitalizing rural north Missouri and term limits.

paragraphs.text: Graduated from Harrisonburg High School, earned a bachelor's degree from James Madison University in 2012 and a graduate degree from Iowa State University in 2016, according to Ballotpedia.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as working as an architect and general contractor.
Describes himself as a licensed architect and small-business owner who runs a local architecture and development firm with his wife in Liberty, Missouri; he is a father of four.
Won the Democratic primary for the 6th District on August 4, 2026; KCUR reports he has not previously held office.

Told St. Louis Public Radio that he decided to run in large part to help Democrats take back the U.S. House; KCUR notes the last time a Democrat held the seat was in 2001, under a different district configuration.
